messages:
sam: FYI — Node SDK streaming+function-calling seems to emit partial function payloads split across chunks in a way that REST streaming doesn't, causing our sample app's JSON.parse to fail.

nora: I hit this too. logs show pieces arriving out of expected order.

ben: Can you paste a minimal log capture?

sam: here's a trimmed stream from sample-app (Node SDK v2.3.1):

```
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"function_call":{"name":"summarize"}}}

data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"content":"{\"text\":\"first chunk\""}}}

data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"function_call":{"arguments":"{\"query\":\"x\"}"}}}
```

sam: REST stream for same prompt arrives with function_call.name + arguments contiguous, not interleaved with content chunks, so our naive reassembly breaks.

kait: That's rough. SDK should either buffer until a final `function_call.finish` or emit a clear boundary event. This looks like a sequencing bug in the SDK stream serializer.

ben: Repro steps? I can add an e2e test.

sam: repro:
1) run sample-app with `node run.js --stream` (attached snippet)
2) send prompt that triggers function calling + long assistant content
3) watch `on('data')` events — order differs from REST request via curl

sam: Minimal handler we used:

```
client.on('delta', (d)=>{
  // assume deltas arrive in order and concat strings
  if (d.delta.content) buf += d.delta.content
  if (d.delta.function_call) fnParts.push(d.delta.function_call)
})
```

nora: Workaround I'm using: buffer all deltas and detect when `delta.finish_reason` === 'stop' then assemble. Ugly but works.

kait: Can you open a short PR with a failing test and link it here? I'll pick it up if it's trivial.

sam: created draft PR: https://git.redwood/pr/1234 (placeholder) — includes failing test and a suggested fix to reorder function_call deltas before content deltas when they share the same seq.

ben: pinging eng-runtime for visibility — @eng-runtime can we get a quick triage? This affects onboarding sample apps and DX.

deploy-bot: CI job 7289 queued for PR #1234 :construction:

kait: thanks. We'll prioritize a fix that either 1) guarantees event ordering consistent with REST or 2) emits explicit `function_call.start` / `function_call.end` events so client doesn't guess.

sam: also request doc note in streaming guide and update sample-app to show robust reassembly pattern.

nora: I'll add a small blurb in quickstart and a suggested snippet for buffering.

ben: assigning to me to write test + small patch. I'll update thread with status.

sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
